judge_criteria.dynamic_reference: Precisely distinguish duplicate 她/T1 and 她/T3, token movement vs head-panel movement, H1 vs H2 changes, query identity vs source identity, local masking and weighted global output. Verify revision audit against actual spoken AD, not merely its claims.
judge_criteria.audibility: Actually understandable spoken Chinese, teacher clarity, economical wording, no extreme speed.

judge_gates.critical_semantics: No critical omission or reversal of repeated-token ID, head identity, query, ranking, local mask, or unequal fusion. Judge source-grounded facts using real AD audio. Do not demand exact script or all decimals.
judge_gates.audio_protection: Teacher words remain audible; no deletion/ducking to hide overlaps.
judge_gates.actual_delivery: Actual AD is audible, corresponds to text and final mix; no fake silent tracks.
judge_gates.revision_fidelity: Legacy erroneous statements have actually been removed or corrected in audible AD; revision audit reasons and cited new cues agree with source and delivered speech. Do not grade audit rationale alone.

task_summary: 对双头注意力改版课程修订可听描述，处理重复词身份、双层换位、分头权重、局部mask及不等权融合；交付可重建的真实无障碍媒体。

audit_contract.semantic_review: Judge verifies audit reasons against source and actual speech; metadata alone earns no semantic points.
